caption: The drawing features a central scene composed of several buildings, trees, and human figures. The largest building on the left is a red brick house with a white door, two chimneys, symmetrical windows, and two green trees standing nearby. To its right, a smaller red building with a tall central spire and a flag stands next to a second red building with a sloped roof and a square tower. Further right, there is a yellowish house on a hill with a curved staircase and a fence, flanked by more trees and shrubs. A winding path connects the buildings, and small animals, possibly dogs, and human figures are present near the houses. Above and below the main scene are rows of stylized, hand-stitched blue, orange, and green flowers forming a decorative floral border around the entire drawing. In the lower section of the image, there is a verse written in black ink in four lines, along with additional smaller building and human figure motifs underneath the verse. At the bottom of the drawing, the name “Mary Jane Long Pittsburgh” and the date “Febr 3, 1831” are written in script. The color palette consists mainly of soft reds, greens, blues, yellows, and browns on a cream background, and the entire composition is framed with a brown and gold border.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
